questions.question: In an examination hall seven students Ankit, Chotu, Jitin, Kejal, Nitu, Piyush, and Saksham are sitting in a row facing North but not necessarily in the same order. Chotu sits third to the right of Saksham. Ankit and Piyush are immediate neighbours of Chotu. More than two persons sit between Piyush and Saksham. Jitin is the only neighbour of Nitu. Jitin sits to the right of Ankit. What is the position of Nitu with respect to Kejal?
questions.solution:
Given: Ankit, Chotu, Jitin, Kejal, Nitu, Piyush, and Saksham are sitting in a row facing North.

1) Chotu sits third to the right of Saksham.

2) Ankit and Piyush are immediate neighbours of Chotu.

3) More than two persons sit between Piyush and Saksham.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58245c6e40ac0fadafbbc82f2ae955cf739e1141f55c8bbe8a085d1220383f95.png] 

4) Jitin is the only neighbour of Nitu and Jitin sits to the right of Ankit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4604bab46787ff42da8733efb8e3e5601b1a9775a803235a38dffb7fc00e6d19.png] 

∴ Here, Position of Nitu is Fifth to the right of Kejal.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Fifth to the right".**

questions.question: Five girls Babita, Lita, Mita, Rita and Tina are playing a game. They are sitting in a row facing towards the north. Mita is sitting at the west end and Tina is sitting at the east end. Babita is sitting to the immediate left of Lita and to the right of Mita. Who is sitting second from the east end?
questions.solution:
Five girls Babita, Lita, Mita, Rita and Tina are playing a game. They are sitting in a row facing towards the north.

1) Mita is sitting at the west end and Tina is sitting at the east end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7327e5b2185c264275c1370a16ba223445ec788deae3c129729a5f045ef02ba8.png] 

2) Babita is sitting to the immediate left of Lita and to the right of Mita.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98a013c44cafe1c56f86c5d106d35af3805542d2b065b06fb851507d2fa1fbf6.png] 

∴ Here, 'Rita' is sitting second from the east end

Hence, the correct answer is **"Rita".**

questions.question: Q, R, and S are sitting in a straight line facing south. U, W, and X are sitting in a parallel line facing north. Q is sitting to the immediate left of S and opposite to W. R who is opposite to U, is to the immediate right of S. Who sits to the immediate right of U?
questions.solution:
Given: Q, R, and S are sitting in a straight line facing south.

U, W, and X are sitting in a parallel line facing north.

1) Q is sitting to the immediate left of S and opposite to W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26cf7c4fd4c5cbb192c6339f7ef272ecca9285c2b766511ac266f05b60c31bee.png] 

2) R who is opposite to U, is to the immediate right of S.

And, X will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/029bc308e06a39049259b0bf26a8b0194b22436dca42b25782b2336d710cd7b0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/029bc308e06a39049259b0bf26a8b0194b22436dca42b25782b2336d710cd7b0.png] 

So, 'X' sits to the immediate right of U.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question: Four boys R, S, T and U are sitting in a row, facing towards the south (but not necessarily in the same order). Four girls A, B, C and D are sitting in a row, facing towards the face of these boys (but not necessarily in the same order). C and R are diagonally opposite to each other. A and S are diagonally opposite to each other. T is the immediate neighbour of R. D is the immediate neighbour of C. Who is facing D?
questions.solution:
Four boys **R, S, T and U** are sitting in a row, facing towards the south (but not necessarily in the same order). Four girls **A, B, C and D** are sitting in a row, facing towards the face of these boys (but not necessarily in the same order). 

1. C and R are diagonally opposite to each other. 

2. T is the immediate neighbour of R.

3. D is the immediate neighbour of C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d1beaa909d645c8eeed8573d2e4ecab45db13b1eb5b77bedcfb52b737ee3e78.png] 

4. A and S are diagonally opposite to each other. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36b38a8f775c1167a4c10093532b37e7635537743e6dd8ea6d3683700fa987af.png] 

U and B will occupy the vacant positions in the respective rows.

The final arrangement will be as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42a43c56564a1c0759844b51c187a1875280c7bba0b9ce2a211a94ad5002bc2f.png] 

Clearly, U is facing D.

Hence, '**U**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Eight girls A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a row, facing towards the north (but not necessarily in the same order). Neither C nor D is at the extreme ends of the row. H is at the extreme right end of the row. Only E is sitting between D and F. Only G is sitting between F and H. C and A are the immediate neighbours of B.Which of the following statements is/are correct?

I. D is fourth to the left of H.

II. D is the immediate neighbour of B.
questions.solution:
Given: Eight girls A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H.

1) H is at the extreme right end of the row.

2) Only G is sitting between F and H.

3) Only E is sitting between D and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c27a1bf1cfa417d10a11302caf468c90e6f88788be745dd63765817d5923983d.png] 

4) C and A are the immediate neighbors of B.

5) Neither C nor D is at the extreme ends of the row. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c52c4ee4ab117732be1b4020152d962f2893e29ed55fc4ecc3aa6e8336341e4f.png] 

Here,

I. D is fourth to the left of H - **True.**

II. D is the immediate neighbor of B - False.

So, 'Only I' statement is true here.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
